mapper.select: SELECT * FROM INQUIRY WHERE MEMBER_NUM = #{memberNum} ORDER BY INQUIRY_REGIST DESC

SELECT i.INQUIRY_NUM, i.MEMBER_NUM, i.EMPLOYEE_NUM, i.INQUIRY_TITLE, i.INQUIRY_CONTENT, i.INQUIRY_REGIST, i.INQUIRY_STATUS, i.ANSWER_CONTENT, i.ANSWER_DATE, m.MEMBER_ID FROM INQUIRY i LEFT JOIN MEMBER m ON i.MEMBER_NUM = m.MEMBER_NUM ORDER BY i.INQUIRY_REGIST DESC

SELECT i.INQUIRY_NUM, i.MEMBER_NUM, i.EMPLOYEE_NUM, i.INQUIRY_TITLE, i.INQUIRY_CONTENT, i.INQUIRY_REGIST, i.INQUIRY_STATUS, i.ANSWER_CONTENT, i.ANSWER_DATE, m.MEMBER_ID FROM INQUIRY i LEFT JOIN MEMBER m ON i.MEMBER_NUM = m.MEMBER_NUM WHERE i.INQUIRY_NUM = #{inquiryNum}
